text:
incident-bot: Alert fired: GPU memory pressure detected in pool 'redwood-gpu-eu-west-1-a'. Metric: gpu_mem_utilization > 92% for 3m. Rule: cuda_alloc_fail_rate > 0.5%
pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty incident SD-4721 created and routed to on-call (level1). Pager: @alex, escalation in 5m. Link: https://pd.example/SD-4721
alex: acked pagerduty SD-4721 :thumbsup: looking now, dropping in
lee: seen. what's the customer impact? any 5xx spikes?
alex: checking logs, a small subset of inference requests hitting large context bfloat models saw repeated `CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY` and `cudaMemcpy` errors. CPU fallback in some routes triggered but latency spiked to ~4s.
maria: dev metrics: request success rate dipped by 1.7% for eu-west-1 region during the spike, most errors from model-id: rwl-13b-ctx8-bf16.
alex: starting quick mitigations: 1) disable prefetch for that model in pool 2) scale up pool by 2 instances (warm spare) 2) enable fallback-route to quantized variant `rwl-13b-q4` for new requests
lee: good. can you post the commands you ran?
alex: ran these: ```
# drain prefetch workers for pool
redwoodctl pool update redwood-gpu-eu-west-1-a --prefetch=false
# scale pool
redwoodctl pool scale redwood-gpu-eu-west-1-a --delta 2
# update routing policy
redwoodctl route update --match model=rwl-13b-ctx8-bf16 --fallback rwl-13b-q4
```
incident-bot: Autoscaler: scale request accepted, 2 new nodes pending (expected 120s to readiness).
lee: can we temporarily evict large-kv caches to reclaim memory? risk of cold starts though.
maria: evicting large prefix caches on pool nodes now: `kvcache evict --pool redwood-gpu-eu-west-1-a --threshold 0.75`
alex: kv evictions started, we might see a small uptick in token-time cost but should free ~10-12GB per node.
oncall-next: heads up I'll take over if this continues past 10:30 UTC.
pagerduty-bot: SD-4721 acknowledged by alex at 10:17 UTC. Escalation timer paused.
lee: monitoring tail-latency and alloc failure counts. setting up a temporary alert for `cuda_alloc_failures > 1/min` to chat.
maria: logs show repetitive stack: ```
RuntimeError: CUDA out of memory at alloc (size=524288000)
  File "/srv/inference/serve.py", line 412, in forward
  ..
```
alex: rolling a canary config to reduce batch size to 1 for model rwl-13b-ctx8-bf16 on pool-a: ```
redwoodctl config set model=rwl-13b-ctx8-bf16 batch.size=1 --pool redwood-gpu-eu-west-1-a --apply-canary=10%
```
lee: if canary is ok increase to 50%, otherwise revert. keep me posted.
incident-bot: Canary applied to 10% of traffic.
alex: initial canary shows reduced OOMs on those traces, but overall alloc failures still near threshold. New nodes are provisioning (1/2 ready).
maria: customer impact list: small-startup.co (1.2% of total qps) saw 500s and increased latency; enterprise-corp queued requests but retried successfully. Filing a quick customer note draft.
lee: I'm going to temporarily route all requests from small-startup.co to `rwl-13b-q4` until we stabilize. alex confirm?
alex: confirm, doing route override: `redwoodctl route set --org small-startup.co --model rwl-13b-q4 --ttl 30m --reason "mitigation for SD-4721"`
incident-bot: Route override applied for small-startup.co -> rwl-13b-q4.
lee: alloc failures dropping to 0.2% after kv-evict + canary + route override. tail latency back to ~700ms.
maria: new nodes ready, joining pool. after node join, we'll restore prefetch with a lower concurrency limit.
oncall-next: I'll take detailed handoff in 5. current state: mitigations applied, PD incident acknowledged, channel monitoring.
alex: handing off to @oncall-next — summary: triggered by sustained gpu_mem_util >92%; mitigations: kvcache evict, canary batch.size=1, route override small-startup.co -> q4, scaled pool +2 nodes. Current status: alloc-failures < 0.5%, latency improving.
oncall-next: ack handoff. I'll keep PD updated and watch for regression. planning next steps: postmortem, add prewarm + kv eviction automation, investigate model memory regression.
pagerduty-bot: SD-4721 note: next escalation scheduled in 1h if incident reopens.
lee: quick note for ops playbook: add `kvcache --evict` to OOM runbook and include route-override example.
maria: drafting incident notification for affected customers, will share for review in #customer-success.
alex: thanks team. please add any logs/snippets to the PD incident and I'll start the memory-profiling ticket. :coffee: 
incident-bot: Channel will remain open for 2h for follow-ups.
oncall-next: closing loop here — leaving this thread open, will update if anything flips.
